calls.price_at_call: ~$343 (stated, same level as before last earnings; it fell to ~$315 after that print)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 2026-10-13; no flip): still undervalued and 'one of the best names to own' — super-profitable core, large cash balance, a name that lets him sleep well and should exit any broad correction stronger.
calls.base_case: Revenue growth accelerates modestly to ~25% for three quarters; Google Cloud grew 81.8% last quarter to $24.7B with expanding margins, and the TPU business starts showing in early 2027.
calls.bull_case: Cloud growth could reach ~100% YoY this quarter and other segments could accelerate enough to flip free cash flow positive ahead of expectations.
calls.bear_case: Free cash flow was -$5.8B last quarter and is expected negative again (-$3.7B, then -$4.6B) on capex expected near $55.3B this quarter; EPS/FCF prints have been erratic.

calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (prior Couch GOOGL BUY; no flip) — collaboration with Rachel (The Motley Fool and Couch Investor): Rachel, a long-term Alphabet shareholder, calls Alphabet a 'continued compelling buy' and Couch explicitly agrees, saying Google/Alphabet is a name he would put on any list. Q2 2026: revenue +24% YoY, search/ads +17%, Google Cloud +82% with $514B backlog; Gemini app 950M MAU, Gemini Enterprise used by ~90% of Fortune 100.
calls.base_case: AI is layered onto search/cloud rather than cannibalising search; search is now ~50% of revenue as Cloud grows faster and becomes extremely profitable; funded by the profitable ads business.
calls.bull_case: TPUs reduce reliance on outside suppliers; Waymo leads US autonomy and is expanding internationally; Isomorphic Labs and other Other Bets add optionality.
calls.bear_case: Heavy AI capex pressures near-term profitability (stock fell after a recent earnings report on spend); regulatory risk is a permanent background factor.
calls.collab_byline: The Motley Fool and Couch Investor

calls.thesis: Highest-conviction long-term holding (largest position); not adding at ~$350 — conditional entry: sell Dec 18 $300 cash-secured put (~$400 premium); would happily take 100 more shares at $300.
calls.bull_case: Broadest AI ecosystem (Search, YouTube, Cloud, Gemini, TPU, Waymo); avg target $432 (+25%).
calls.bear_case: Macro headwinds (rates, inflation, midterms) + index at ATHs = patience over chasing.

calls.thesis: Still holding and not selling: Gemini 4 looks frontier/well-rounded, and Google's distribution, full stack and half-price positioning let it undercut debt-laden OpenAI/Anthropic without needing direct Gemini monetization.
calls.bull_case: Gemini 4 benchmarks hold up and Google converts distribution (Android/Gmail/YouTube/Drive) into AI share.

calls.bull_case: Supply-constrained Cloud growth unleashed; Gemini monetization scales.
calls.bear_case: Mag-7 concentration; AI capex cycle pressures margins.
